messages:
suresh: Heads-up — saw a p95 regression on h100 pools for rwl-large-v2 after last deploy. Looks like kernel routing is oscillating to CUTLASS during KV-cache cold probes, causing higher tail latency. cc @kaylee @maria

kaylee: Can you paste the perf dump + probe plan? Which seqlen slices are hit?

suresh: Quick dump: 
```
time window: 2026-02-25T14:02Z
sample_count: 512
seqlen_dist: {<=32: 60%, 33-64: 25%, 65-128: 15%}
p50_triton: 55ms, p95_triton: 120ms
p50_cutlass: 60ms, p95_cutlass: 200ms
probe_switches: 104 -> CUTLASS
kv_cache_hitrate_probe: 0.12
kv_cache_hitrate_live: 0.72
```
So probes are mainly seeing cold KV (hitrate 12%) and pick CUTLASS because it wins median, but live traffic is KV-hot and Triton should be preferred. Result: flip-flop and worse p95 overall.

oleg: That gap in kv hitrate between probe and live is huge. Our probe sampler is uniform; it's sampling cold requests. We should bias probes toward KV-hot affinity so probes reflect steady-state behavior.

maria: Also our kernel-decider is stateless for short windows — it uses instantaneous latency deltas and flips quickly. We need hysteresis + an affinity-weighted score (KV weight) so cold probes don't override the longer-term choice.

kaylee: Quick config proposal to test: 
```
kernel_decider:
  probe_ratio: 0.05
  sample_bias:
    kv_hot_weight: 3.0
  hysteresis_ms: 200
  min_stable_samples: 50
  score_metric: median_of_last_n
```
Change score from single-sample p50 to median-of-last-5/10 to reduce noise.

infra-bot: deploy-pipeline started for branch eng-runtime/kvd-probe-bias at commit abc123

suresh: I have a recorded 1h replay of production-ish traffic (includes KV warming behavior). Can we run with the new probe bias and compare p95 / kernel-switch rate?

oleg: I'll queue a replay on a dedicated test pod and capture kernel-routing telemetry. Plan: run baseline (current config) + biased-probe config, each 1h. I'll capture: p50/p95, kernel_switch_count, kv_hitrate_by_slice.

maria: If the biased probe reduces switch_count and improves p95 without harming p50, we can do a 10% canary. Also add a penalty term: if kv_hitrate_delta > 0.4 then subtract X from cutlass_score to discourage CUTLASS selection on warmed caches.

kaylee: Another safety net: require min_stable_samples before accepting a kernel switch in a direction that increases p95. Prevents short cold blips from flipping routing.

suresh: I'll open a PR with the probe-bias + hysteresis changes and add unit tests for weighted sampling and scoring. Assigning review to @kaylee, perf verification to @oleg. TL;DR: root cause = probe sampling sees KV-cold; fix = bias probes toward KV-hot, add hysteresis and p95-aware scoring. :thumbsup:

kaylee: Ack — will review today.

oleg: Replay queued. Expected runtime ~45m to collect stable metrics.

infra-bot: canary-deploy finished for canary id 42 (10%) — monitoring channel eng-runtime-alerts

suresh: Thanks everyone — will follow up with PR link and perf diffs once replay finishes.
